description:
Your whole financial life, answered in ChatGPT.

Connect your accounts once, then just ask: "Where did my money go this month?", "How much lands on payday?", "What's hurting my credit score?" Money by Checkr answers from your real data across checking, savings, credit cards, loans, investments, and payroll.

What you can ask about
• Spending: balances, transactions, and a breakdown by category or merchant
• Bills and subscriptions: recurring charges and recurring income
• Income: gross vs. net pay, taxes, benefits, retirement contributions, and pay history
• Net worth: assets and debts over time, with credit limits, APR, and loan terms
• Credit: your score, what's moving it, utilization, and 24 months of payment history

Keep your data tidy
Ask Money by Checkr to fix a category, rename a merchant, hide a transaction, or set a rule for a merchant going forward. It confirms before changing many transactions at once.

Private and secure
Money by Checkr can never move your money. 256-bit AES encryption. No ads. Requires Money Pro.

defaultPrompt: Where is my money really going?
What's my net worth right now?
What subscriptions am I paying for?
